```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(bench))
stopifnot(exists("mtlapply"), exists("background"), exists("wait"))
old <- options(mtlapply.threads = 8L)
```

## Context

This script demonstrates two workflows where the thread pool is useful:

1. Data-parallel compute with `mtlapply()`
2. Next-ready asynchronous workflow with `background()` + `wait()`

```{r}
sessionInfo()
```

## 1) `mtlapply()` scaling benchmark

```{r}
A <- matrix(runif(10000), 100, 100)
B <- matrix(runif(10000), 100, 100)
X <- 1:10000
task <- function(i) A %*% B + i

res_apply <- bench::mark(
  lapply = lapply(X, task),
  mtlapply_1 = { options(mtlapply.threads = 1L); mtlapply(X, task) },
  mtlapply_2 = { options(mtlapply.threads = 2L); mtlapply(X, task) },
  mtlapply_4 = { options(mtlapply.threads = 4L); mtlapply(X, task) },
  mtlapply_8 = { options(mtlapply.threads = 8L); mtlapply(X, task) },
  iterations = 5,
  check = FALSE
)
res_apply_tbl <- res_apply[, c("expression", "min", "median", "itr/sec", "mem_alloc")]
knitr::kable(res_apply_tbl)
```

```{r}
med_apply_sec <- as.numeric(res_apply$median) / 1e9
barplot(
  med_apply_sec,
  names.arg = as.character(res_apply$expression),
  las = 2,
  ylab = "Median elapsed (s)",
  main = "mtlapply scaling"
)
```

## 2) `background()` + `wait()` next-ready benchmark

```{r}
work <- function(n) {
  x <- seq_len(n)
  sum(sin(x) * cos(x))
}
jobs <- sample(80000:180000, 16, replace = TRUE)

run_serial <- function() lapply(jobs, work)

run_parallel <- function() {
  options(mtlapply.threads = 8L)
  futs <- lapply(jobs, function(n) background(work(n)))
  pending <- Map(function(id, fut) list(id = id, fut = fut), seq_along(futs), futs)
  out <- vector("list", length(futs))
  while (length(pending)) {
    done <- wait(lapply(pending, `[[`, "fut"))
    i <- attr(done, "index")
    id <- pending[[i]]$id
    out[[id]] <- done$value
    pending <- pending[-i]
  }
  out
}

# correctness check
s <- run_serial()
p <- run_parallel()
stopifnot(identical(s, p))
```

```{r}
res_bg <- bench::mark(
  serial = run_serial(),
  background_wait = run_parallel(),
  iterations = 5,
  check = FALSE
)
res_bg_tbl <- res_bg[, c("expression", "min", "median", "itr/sec", "mem_alloc")]
knitr::kable(res_bg_tbl)
```

```{r}
med_bg_sec <- as.numeric(res_bg$median) / 1e9
barplot(
  med_bg_sec,
  names.arg = as.character(res_bg$expression),
  las = 2,
  ylab = "Median elapsed (s)",
  main = "background()/wait()"
)
```
